maplibre.reason: Pinned stable classic-script v5 release, matching the provider quick-start integration.

style.changes: English name:en/name_en, then name:latin, then local name; empty names skipped. Muted water and airport labels. Stronger country and region boundaries, quieter local boundaries. No relief, satellite, terrain or 3D layers.

service.notes: Public tiles need no key and have no stated request limits; service is as-is without an SLA. Provider/CDN receives IP and map resource requests. No geocoding requests.
